# Correction: the Gloda compaction snapshot names the statement and block-fetch method

The earlier source snapshot at lines3116–3140 names getMessagesByMessageKey in metadata. The actual checked code contains the _folderCompactionStatement getter and folderCompactionPassBlockFetch method. Use the corrected snapshot for those symbols. Its text, blob and revision are unchanged. This corrects the source locator only; the compaction findings and audit count do not change.

Scope: Gloda source identity correction.
